hook: A tearful dad in a podcast studio describes a scary online challenge that involved his young son
checked: Viewed all 8 frames: podcast interview, man in a cap and white tee, tearful, subtitles about a 'challenge' and 'hanging themselves'
The claim that a specific YouTube cartoon taught the challenge is a headline from the source post with no official source (AAP/CDC/NHS/WHO); not verifiable
Story is anecdotal and the source post frames it as fear-based ("could be dangerous", "truth-bomb")
reject: The clip describes a hanging/strangulation 'challenge' that a child nearly died from. Detailing it could lead kids to imitate it and touches on self-harm without safe-messaging. It also exposes a near-fatal private moment of a minor, and the claim that a YouTube cartoon caused it is unverified. Not suitable for our audience or tone (no fear-mongering).
